title: Sing It Back
style: Indie-pop with a driving midtempo pulse, syncopated drum programming, fingerpicked acoustic guitar layered with glassy synth plucks; verse rides close-mic storytelling, pre-chorus strips to bass and snaps, chorus hits with stacked gang vocals and a lifted harmony on the hook. Vocal doubles in verses, delay throws on key phrases, reversed swells into the chorus, tiny terminal blips and chime accents between lines; bright, polished, intimate mix with punchy low end., clean, dynamic, harmony, strong, warm, simple
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Sing it back, sing it back
the seamstress takes the thread
SSH into the VDS
Tailscale the spread
No Postman at the door
we build the REST
Pick up the crumbs
construct the mansion, pass the test

Sixty-two domains
in the JSON, query the source
No hard-coded numbers
dynamic force
Hermes wizard running
Grok to OpenRouter flow
API keys in the .env
never in the show

[Pre-Chorus]
The terminal timed out
on one sixty-one point ninety-seven point eighty-nine point forty-nine
But the config lives in ~/.hermes
the setup is alive
Claude Fable at ten dollars
Kimi K2.6 at sixty-eight
We pick the model by the task
not by the rate

[Chorus]
Sing it back, sing it back (sing it back)
Seamstress, thread by thread
Sing it back, sing it back (sing it back)
Build the house inside your head
Sing it back, sing it back (sing it back)
No throne, just hands and code
Sing it back, sing it back
We make the whole road

[Verse 2]
Seamstress victory
signal weave complete
Domain registry locked
every platform in the seat
Gmail to Kelvin
legal draft moving clean
Concerns Notice bilingual
the framing is seen

Now for the setup you asked
Kimi with Ollama and Hermes
G4 style
On the VDS
root at one sixty-one point ninety-seven point eighty-nine point forty-nine
Bash one

Install Ollama
pull strong local models
Hermes memory layer
long-term memory settings
Kimi WebBridge
FastAPI or Flask
Use your Kimi API key in .env
never in code, ask

[Pre-Chorus]
Use the Nginx reverse proxy
Route kimi, ollama, hermes inside
Bruno collections to Git hook
Hoppscotch sync on the glide
All sixty-two domains
self-hosted, no heavy external Postman
The bash is the boss
the VDS is the mansion

[Chorus]
Sing it back, sing it back (sing it back)
Seamstress, thread by thread
Sing it back, sing it back (sing it back)
Build the house inside your head
Sing it back, sing it back (sing it back)
No throne, just hands and code
Sing it back, sing it back
We make the whole road

[Bridge]
Nginx template lives
where you left it
Git hook is chmod plus x
Ollama is warm
Hermes config in ~/.hermes
Kimi bridge you build once
then it lives forever
behind your internal SSL

No SaaS throne
the bash is the boss
VDS mansion rising
super intelligence gloss
The bru CLI is installed
the hook is chmod plus x
The Nginx config is sites-enabled
everything clicks

[Final Chorus]
Sing pal, sing it back (sing it back)
Your voice is the root I need
Sing pal, sing it back (sing it back)
You’re the thread and I’m the seam
Sing pal, sing it back (sing it back)
Sixty-two pages, one stack
Sing pal, sing it back
We don’t look back

Sing pal, sing it back (sing it back)
In-house, self-made, we ride
Sing pal, sing it back (sing it back)
The Moderato Plan is paid
Sing pal, sing it back (sing it back)
In code, in rhyme, in the bash
Sing pal, sing it back
This is our machine

[Outro]
The bru CLI is installed
The hook is chmod plus x
The Nginx config is sites-enabled
Ollama is serving hermes-3 plus mistral
Hermes memory layer is listening
Kimi WebBridge scaffold is ready
Your move, Sing Pal
What thread do we pull next?
